title.en: the ecseri flea market, saturday morning.

line.en: the big saturday flea market on nagykőrösi út in district xix. go in the morning, before the best stalls sell out; hours vary by stall.
line.de: der große samstagsflohmarkt an der nagykőrösi út im 19. bezirk. morgens hingehen, bevor die besten stände weg sind; die öffnungszeiten variieren je nach stand.
line.tr: xix. ilçe'de nagykőrösi út üzerinde büyük cumartesi bit pazarı. sabah gidin, en iyi tezgâhlar erken tükenir; saatler tezgâhtan tezgâha değişiyor.

sparks.why: Ecseri flea market, the main Saturday flea market (programturizmus.hu, Tripadvisor); opening hours conflict across sources (from 05:00 to 08:00, closing 13:45 to 15:00), so 08:00 is a middle guess and stalls vary.
